SELECT a.id, a.name, a.trigger_type, a.trigger_config, a.condition_tree, a.is_active, a.created_at,
  (SELECT MAX(r.ran_at) FROM automation_runs r WHERE r.automation_id = a.id) AS last_run_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM automation_runs r WHERE r.automation_id = a.id AND r.status = 'success') AS run_count,
  COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object('id', ac.id, 'branch', ac.branch, 'action_type', ac.action_type, 'action_config', ac.action_config, 'sort_order', ac.sort_order)
      ORDER BY ac.sort_order
    ) FILTER (WHERE ac.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS actions
FROM automations a
LEFT JOIN automation_actions ac ON ac.automation_id = a.id
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;
SELECT id, role, active FROM users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO automations (id, name, trigger_type, trigger_config, condition_tree, is_active, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (COALESCE($1, nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('automations', 'id'))), $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, true, $6, now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  trigger_type = EXCLUDED.trigger_type,
  trigger_config = EXCLUDED.trigger_config,
  condition_tree = EXCLUDED.condition_tree,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO automation_actions (automation_id, branch, action_type, action_config, sort_order)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5);
SELECT id, role, active FROM users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;
